messages:
Rae (Product): Quick thread 1 — large EU customer asked for a production plan that guarantees EU data residency + sub-50ms p50 for EU traffic. Need product path + launch gates. Proposing three minimal paths: Shielded Tenant, Region-Affinity, and Pilot Hybrid. Thoughts?

Nina (Infra): Shielded = dedicated in-region pools. Affinity = steer->closest with fallbacks. Hybrid = shielded for paid tenants, affinity for others. Cost and ops vary a lot.

Leo (Arch): Suggest concrete gates: provisioning SLA, p50/p99 targets, KMS attestation, and model-fallback parity checks. Also note routing template bookkeeping.

Priya (SRE): Ops must have automated canary rollback, noisy-tenant eviction runbook, and per-tenant telemetry. Launch gate: 48h canary with zero customer-facing errors.

Marta (Sales): Customer will sign pilot if we commit to an 8-week pilot and isolation for them. Need a one-pager for security review.

Sam (CustSuccess): Pilot acceptance tests: latency probes from EU edges, audit log export test, and a data residency verification checklist.

Rae (Product): Quick tradeoffs I put here:
- Shielded Tenant: Pros deterministic latency & compliance; Cons higher cost, longer lead time (6-9w). Gates: autoscale + KMS + audit export validated.
- Region-Affinity: Pros fast onboard, lower cost; Cons possible noisy neighbors. Gates: fallback latency <300ms, misroute alarms.
- Pilot Hybrid: Pros immediate revenue + compliance for pilot; Cons dual-path complexity. Gates: both sets above for pilot tenant.

Leo (Arch): Minimal routing pseudo:
```
if region=="eu" && label=="shielded" -> pool("eu-shielded")
else if region=="eu" -> prefer(pool("eu-affinity"))
fallback -> pool("global-shared")
```

Nina (Infra): Dev roughs: Shielded 8-10w, Affinity 3-4w, Hybrid 6-8w. All assume existing autoscaler and pool APIs.

Priya (SRE): Add to ticket: canary ramp 0%->10%->50%->100% over 72h for pilot, error budget <0.01% during ramp, and p99 regression threshold.

Rae (Product): Actions: Nina drop estimates into RFC by Tue; Leo lead model-fallback spike (1w); Priya draft SRE checklist; Marta confirm pilot signoff. Will lock path Friday unless objections.

ops-bot: Please attach RFC to /rfc and tag @sre-runbooks.

Marta (Sales): Ill confirm pilot customer and InfoSec contacts.

Sam (CustSuccess): Ill prepare the acceptance test plan for the pilot.

Rae (Product): Thanks all. If no objections Ill file the RFC and schedule kickoff. :thumbsup:
